scope: Bounded local source/static reader website audit; no Studio, browser session, network action or publication

guidance.approach: Existing native controls, Baseline history/pageshow; no new dependencies

findings.status: confirmed source-level defect; current browser reproduction pending
findings.finding: Poet search results do not reconcile browser-restored form values on Back. Pagination/show-more limit and scroll have no history-entry state.
findings.evidence: Executed current poet-directory.js in VM: after simulated restored query Sasmita Rout and pageshow, progress remains Showing 12 of 24 and matching target at position 21 remains hidden. No pageshow handler exists.
findings.proposed_fix: Save query, visible limit and scroll in current history entry; restore before render and on pageshow, preserve BFCache state and independent visits.

findings.status: measured payload and confirmed repeated work; interaction latency not measured
findings.finding: 5.53 MB initial HTML contains 4.23 MB searchable full poem/translation text. Each search keystroke normalizes every row again.
findings.proposed_fix: First cache normalized search strings once; preserve current whole-text matching. Treat splitting/lazy-loading the search index as separate measured architecture work, not an automatic fix.
findings.limits: Local gzip estimate is not measured HTTP transfer. No claim of failed Core Web Vitals or field INP.

contrast.method: WCAG relative-luminance calculation of current explicit Ink & Voice tokens; not computed rendered styles
contrast.result: All sampled text pairs exceed 4.5:1. Pseudo-element/image backgrounds, disabled states and full interactive contrast not certified.

keyboard.current_source: Poem language tabs implement ArrowLeft/Right/Home/End with roving tabindex. Existing native modal/menu handlers retain focus return. No new confirmed keyboard defect from bounded source inspection.
